about: THE GOVERNMENT DOCUMENTS' OWN SECTION HEADINGS, exact, extracted once from the gov.uk PDFs each country file's `docs` names (26 Nov: pdftotext; the GCSE science sub-headings from the PDFs' bold type). Per subject, per document: `cite`, the content sections, each of which some node's `src.ref` must cite; `groups`, the headings above them a broader node may cite; `skills`, the working-mathematically / working-scientifically strands, which are skills, not content, so no node need cite them. A year-by-year document's section is `Y<n> <heading>`; a group there is the heading itself, every year it appears. A GCSE science section is `<topic> – <sub-heading>`. GCSE maths statements (N1–S6) are the maths file's `statements`, not listed here. Checked by tools/one-curriculum.js: every `ref` is one of these, every `cite` heading is cited.
